premise: Ladybug counts her own six spots easily, but Deer's won't hold still, Frog's go SNAP in the middle of catching a fly, Mushroom's get the giggles, and Duckling has none — so they count the friends instead.
inspiration: Folk counting rhymes and the uncountable-stars motif, turned into a giggle: the one thing that never wiggles out of the count is your friends.
lesson: Everyone counts, spots or no spots.

en-US.title: Ladybug Counts the Spots
en-US.text: {ladybug:enter} Ladybug loved counting. [excited] First, her own spots. One, two, three, four, five… SIX! {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} Easy! Next, {deer:enter} Deer's spots. {ladybug:go to deer} She crawled over. One, two, thr… but Deer {deer:live} bent down for a nibble and flicked his ears. {ladybug:face surprised} Oh! Where was I? {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog, then, sitting in the pond! {ladybug:go to frog by fly} {sfx:whirr} Ladybug flew over. [whispers] Hold still, please. {frog:live hold} Frog froze. Perfect. One, two, three, four… {frog:live resume} {sfx:snap} SNAP! Frog caught a fly. [laughs] Oh, FROG! Then {mushroom:enter} Mushroom's spots… {mushroom:wobble} but Mushroom got the giggles. Lost again! Along waddled {duckling:enter} Duckling. Count mine! Ladybug looked. Fluff. Fluff. More fluff. {duckling:face sad} No spots at all. [softly] Then you're the easiest, said Ladybug. ONE Duckling! {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} So they counted friends instead. Ladybug, one! Deer, two! Frog, three! Duckling, four! Mushroom, five! {all:face happy} {ladybug:live} Ladybug fluttered her wings and took a bow. [happily] And not one of them wiggled… much.

es-ES.title: Mariquita cuenta lunares
es-ES.text: {ladybug:enter} A Mariquita le encantaba contar. [excited] Primero, sus propios lunares. Uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco… ¡SEIS! {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} ¡Facilísimo! Ahora, los lunares de {deer:enter} Ciervo. {ladybug:go to deer} Se acercó. Uno, dos, tr… pero Ciervo {deer:live} bajó la cabeza a mordisquear y movió las orejas. {ladybug:face surprised} ¡Oh! ¿Por dónde iba? {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} ¡Pues Rana, que está en la charca! {ladybug:go to frog by fly} {sfx:whirr} Mariquita fue volando. [whispers] Quieta, por favor. {frog:live hold} Rana se quedó inmóvil. Perfecto. Uno, dos, tres, cuatro… {frog:live resume} {sfx:snap} ¡ZAS! Rana cazó una mosca. [laughs] ¡Ay, RANA! Luego, los lunares de {mushroom:enter} Seta… {mushroom:wobble} pero a Seta le entró la risa. ¡Otra vez perdida! Llegó bamboleándose {duckling:enter} Patito. ¡Cuenta los míos! Mariquita miró. Plumón. Plumón. Más plumón. {duckling:face sad} Ni un lunar. [softly] Pues tú eres el más fácil, dijo Mariquita. ¡UN Patito! {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} Así que contaron amigos. ¡Mariquita, uno! ¡Ciervo, dos! ¡Rana, tres! ¡Patito, cuatro! ¡Seta, cinco! {all:face happy} {ladybug:live} Mariquita agitó las alas e hizo una reverencia. [happily] Y ninguno se movió… casi.

whirr.prompt: a ladybug's tiny wings whirring as it takes off, very light and close

snap.prompt: a quick wet comic tongue flick and a tiny gulp, playful
